prompt:
Implement the VCF Operations 9.0 asynchronous content-import client in this Go repository. The pinned REST contract is in docs/contract.json and its official-source provenance is in docs/official_sources.json. Complete Client.ImportAndWait in client.go so it submits content with operationId importContent and polls operationId getLastImportOperation until the operation reaches a terminal state.

The POST must use /suite-api/api/content/operations/import, send exactly one multipart/form-data part named contentFile with the caller's filename and bytes, request JSON, and require HTTP 202. Send the configured Authorization value verbatim on every request. ImportOptions.Force is optional: omit the force query parameter when it is nil, while preserving an explicitly set false value as force=false. ImportOptions.EncryptionPassword is optional and an empty value must omit the EncryptionPassword header rather than send an empty header.

After the accepted response, poll GET /suite-api/api/content/operations/import. NOT_INITIALIZED, INITIALIZED, and RUNNING are non-terminal. Return the ImportResult only for FINISHED. Return an *OperationError carrying the terminal details for FAILED or UNKNOWN. Waiting between non-terminal polls must honor context cancellation and must not impose an independent attempt limit. The loopback mock records requests and exposes only the two named contract operations; no live VMware endpoint is needed. All table-driven acceptance tests must pass under go test -race ./...
